MEYA HOLDINGS LTD is hiring a
Web3 Junior Market Analyst (Remote)

Compensation: $60k - $82k

Location: Remote

6d ago

 MEYA HOLDINGS LTD is an international company specializing in digital assets, cryptocurrency markets, and financial research. We focus on developing data-driven trading approaches and optimizing market operations. Our remote team brings together professionals from different parts of the world.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Market Analyst with at least 1 year of experience in cryptocurrency or financial trading. You will assist with market analysis, monitor trading performance, and contribute to improving our daily operational processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor cryptocurrency prices, trading volumes, and market developments.
  • Analyze market data and identify potential trading opportunities.
  • Assist with daily Spot, Futures, and Options trading activities.
  • Monitor asset allocation across centralized and decentralized exchanges.
  • Prepare reports on market conditions and trading performance.
  • Identify operational or technical issues and coordinate with the relevant teams.
  • Monitor automated trading systems and ensure compliance with risk management rules.
  • Maintain accurate financial and operational records.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to improve trading processes.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with no geographical restrictions.
  • Flexible working hours across different time zones.
  • Access to professional trading platforms and analytical tools.
  • Opportunity to gain practical experience in digital asset markets.
  • Career development opportunities within an international company.
  • Friendly working environment with ongoing support and feedback.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in cryptocurrency, trading, or financial analysis.
  • Knowledge of centralized and decentralized exchanges (CEX and DEX).
  • Basic understanding of technical analysis and market indicators.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and responsibility.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with a remote team.
